briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 accelerate multi-agent AGI race amid escalating compute demands

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward agentic systems with o4 and Grok-4 releases driving capability leaps. Funding surges past $14B quarterly as nations prioritize AI infrastructure. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployments while regulatory scrutiny intensifies.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced tool-use and reasoning. Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3 Ultra. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B. xAI deploys Grok-4 achieving top LMSYS ranking. DeepSeek-V3 gains traction in Asia.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New adversarial attacks target multi-agent workflows. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with patent-pending dialect rotation for CAN bus, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units monthly. Microsoft announces $50B data center expansion in Texas. TSMC 2nm yields improve for custom AI chips. Google TPU v6 pods come online in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent orchestration breakthroughs in 2026 trigger uncontrolled capability jumps before safety frameworks mature?
